name: DashCore
description: DashCore 0.8.5-alpha: Android64 diagnostic build for Geometry Dash. Corrects trigger ID sample selection so trigger samples are not limited to the first 24 arbitrary GameObjects. No rendering optimization is enabled; live culling remains hard-disabled.

experimental-render-culling.name: Experimental render culling (locked off)
experimental-render-culling.description: Diagnostic alpha only. Live object hiding is hard-disabled until trigger classification and camera-space bounds are validated.
